says: The same person keeps two personal sources on their desktop (notes/retry.md and notes/decisions.md). They enroll the laptop's key while both devices are reachable; from then on the laptop cannot reach the desktop. On the laptop they bind the same repository, commit an instructions and a knowledge source, and found a Team 'Platform'. One read of the selected knowledge and memory (reader.body.read) checks the repository knowledge and finds nothing for the question, and names the desktop note as remote_unknown and the desktop decisions as missing here, with carrier_unreachable and retry of the same request; a read of the Team's instructions is denied (access_not_established), which is not an empty answer. The entry (surface.drive) shows each position with its own state — installed, checked_empty, remote_unknown, missing, denied and not_checked — every selected one still selected, and a start that uses this device's material. Enter dispatches one preparation.compose over the repository, personal and Team scopes that states only local reach and carries the instructions unit; route.select answers for it. Negative: the unreachable desktop and Team empty no selection and are never shown as empty or current, no step signs in, refreshes access or syncs, and the preparation claims no reach it did not have.

set.value: The host session read the prepared material it was handed.
